articles.summary: Interparfums’ shareholders are hereby informed that its combined Annual General Meeting will be held on: Friday, April 24, 2026 at 2 p.m. (Welcome of participants starting at 1 p.m.) Au Pavillon d’Armenonville, Allée de Longchamp, Bois de Boulogne – 75116 PARIS Press release
articles.title: Combined Ordinary and Extraordinary 2026 Annual General Meeting
